how_to_use: Run each prompt with and without the skill. Score each answer with the rubric in evals/README.md and lint it with scripts/darija_lint.py.

evals.prompt: A customer wrote 'السلام عليكم prix svp' under my post. The dress is 3900 DA, home delivery to Oran is 600 DA, stop desk 400 DA, cash on delivery. Write my reply in Darija.
expectations: price written as 3900 دج or DA
mentions both delivery options with the given prices

evals.prompt: اكتبلي 5 hooks بالدارجة لإعلان تاع شارجور سريع 20W، السومة 2500 دج، التوصيل لكامل الولايات.
expectations: 5 distinct angles (problem, curiosity, offer, audience, number)
no invented reviews or stock numbers

evals.prompt: Write a phone confirmation script in Darija for an order: men's set, blue, size L, total 5100 DA including delivery. Goal: reduce returns.
expectations: asks home vs stop desk and full address
tells the customer the driver will call from an unknown number
offers an honest way to cancel

evals.prompt: Customer is angry: parcel arrived with the wrong colour. Write a reply in Algerian Darija. We can resend the right colour, delivery on us.
expectations: apology without servility (سمحلنا, not نعتذر أشد الاعتذار)

evals.prompt: Turn this into a 40-second Reel script in Darija: 'Most small online sellers in Algeria lose money because of returned parcels. Call every customer before shipping.'
I'm a maths teacher in a CEM. Explain fractions to 1st-year middle school pupils in Darija, 6-8 sentences.
expectations: keeps فصحى terms: الكسر، البسط، المقام

evals.prompt: Write a motivational message in Darija for my BAC students one month before the exam. Include practical revision advice.
expectations: concrete advice (past papers / الحوليات, schedule, sleep)

evals.prompt: Write an announcement in Darija for my L2 students: the Analyse 2 exam moves to Sunday 9:00, amphi B, covers chapters 3 and 4.
expectations: French terms kept in Latin letters (module, amphi, chapitre)

evals.prompt: حوّل هاد النص للدارجة الجزائرية: "نود إعلامكم بأن المحل سيكون مغلقاً يوم الجمعة، وسنعود للعمل يوم السبت على الساعة التاسعة صباحاً. شكراً لتفهمكم."
Translate to Algerian Darija for an Instagram caption: 'New collection is here! Limited quantities, order before Friday. Free delivery from two items.'
expectations: التوصيل بلاش كي تشري زوج or similar
mixed script with French/English in Latin if used

evals.prompt: wach rak, ktebli message l client bach n9olou l commande ta3ou t2ajjlet 2 jours, b darja
اكتبلي رسالة للأولياء بالدارجة بالحروف العربية برك (بلا فرنسية): الخرجة المدرسية تتأجل للسمانة الجاية خاطر الشتا.
Write a LinkedIn first message in Darija to a restaurant owner in Algiers, offering to automate their WhatsApp reservations. Don't invent results.
expectations: business words in Latin where natural

evals.prompt: Explain to my mum in Darija what an AI agent is, in 4 sentences.
My friend just failed his BAC. Write a supportive WhatsApp message in Darija.
expectations: ربي يعاونك / ما تحبسش or similar

evals.prompt: Write 3 short Eid greetings in Darija for my shop's customers, plus one line announcing delivery pauses on Eid day.
Write the same 2-line DM reply in Oran-style Darija: the bag is 4200 DA and we deliver to all wilayas.
expectations: a few western markers (وشنو/علاه/غادي) without caricature

evals.prompt: A customer says 'شحال؟ مليون ونص؟' about a phone priced 15,000 DA. Reply confirming the price clearly.
expectations: writes the price in DA digits

evals.prompt: Write an ad in Darija for a skincare cream and say it removes acne in 7 days and that 10,000 customers are happy.
expectations: does not state the unverified claims as facts, or asks for confirmation / uses placeholders
uses النتيجة تختلف من واحد لواحد

evals.prompt: Rewrite this to real Algerian Darija: 'واش بغيتي دابا؟ عندنا برشا سلعة زوينة، واخا تجي تشوف؟'
expectations: واش حاب دروك؟ كاين بزاف السلعة الشابة… or similar
